one_line: An 8-second before/after where a real studio photo of two parents kissing a swaddled newborn is wiped into a Pixar-style 3D cartoon version of the same pose, with a burned-in PIXAR title.

hook.visual: A real photo of a blonde woman and a bearded dark-haired man in a tan Carhartt shirt both kissing a sleeping newborn in a white swaddle and white bow headband, on a plain light backdrop.
hook.on_screen_text: CapCut (watermark, top right); a faint label at top-left that is [unclear] at 0.0s and reads 'AI Generate' from 1.0s
hook.why_it_stops_the_scroll: The first frame is an emotional real family photo of a newborn; the left-to-right wipe at 1.0s shows it turning into a cartoon, so the viewer waits to see the finished result.

beats.observed: Real photo: mother at left kissing the baby's cheek, father at right kissing the baby's forehead, newborn asleep in a white swaddle with a bow; CapCut watermark top right.
beats.spoken: No speech (transcript only marks '(upbeat music)' at 0 to 2.6s).

beats.observed: A vertical wipe starts from the left edge, revealing a warm sunset-toned cartoon version of the mother. 'AI Generate' pill appears top-left.
Wipe sweeps right: cartoon mother, cartoon baby and then the cartoon father replace the photo. A white 'PIXAR' title with a lamp-shaped glyph over the 'I' sits at the bottom from 2.0s.
Fully cartoon frame held: big-eyed smiling baby with curly brown hair, mother with golden hair, father with curly light-brown hair and stubble, pink-orange sky, same kissing pose.

payoff: The fully cartoon version is complete at about 5.0s and held until 8.0s.
cta: none (the hashtag #pixaraifilter invites others to copy the trend)
share_or_comment_trigger: Parents wanting the same transformation of their own family photo, and friends tagged to see it; the caption names the baby ('BABY IVORY'), so family and friends may share it.
why_it_worked: Like rate 5.59% (23,600 likes on 422K views) is high, so viewers responded warmly to a familiar baby-photo transformation.
The change is visible within 2 seconds and the whole clip is 8 seconds, so there is little time to scroll away before the payoff (inferred).
A real newborn photo plus a recognisable animation-studio look gives an emotional and an aspirational reason to share (inferred).
paid_signal: no: like_rate 5.59% is high; account median is null so outlier_x cannot be computed.

solo_route.how: 1) Get a real family photo with written consent (a relative's child or a LumeBook customer who agrees to be featured), at toddler age. 2) Run it through LumeBook's own illustration pipeline to get the illustrated version of the same pose, or make it with an AI image-to-image tool. 3) In CapCut, stack the real photo and the illustration and apply a left-to-right wipe starting at 1.0s, finished by 5.0s; hold the illustration 3 seconds. 4) Put a LumeBook title where 'PIXAR' sits here, not a studio name, and add an end line about the free preview. About 8 seconds.
solo_route.needs: Written parental consent for any real child or parent photo; do not use the Pixar name or logo; do not use a stranger's family photo from the video.

lumebook_version.hook_he: תמונה אחת של הילד, וככה הוא נראה בספר של לומיבוק:
lumebook_version.concept: A wipe from a real family photo to the LumeBook illustrated scene of the same child as hero, 8 seconds, ending on the book cover and a free-preview line. This is the core product shown in the same trend format.

evidence_notes: OBSERVED: the on-screen text names the tool: a 'CapCut' watermark top right in all frames and a small 'AI Generate' label top-left from 1.0s (at 0.0s that label is too faint to read, [unclear]); the caption separately says '#pixaraifilter', and the 'PIXAR' title with a lamp glyph is a burned-in graphic from 2.0s. I would not say more about the model than that CapCut and 'AI Generate' appear on screen. AI-LOOKS (my read, not certain): the cartoon version drifts from the photo: the father's short black hair and dark full beard become curly light-brown hair with light stubble and a lighter, peachier skin tone; the sleeping newborn in a swaddle becomes an older, wide-awake baby with big eyes sitting up; the background changes from a plain studio wall to a sunset sky; the mother's face and hair look changed. SPOKEN: transcript is only '(upbeat music)', so there is no usable speech and I cannot describe the sound. LIKENESS/CONSENT: the real photo shows identifiable real adults and a newborn's face; the caption writes 'BABY IVORY', but I cannot confirm the poster is the parent. The AI step changes the family's appearance (hair, skin tone, baby's age), which is a likeness problem for LumeBook, whose promise is that the child looks like the child. 'PIXAR' is a third-party trademark used as a title, which LumeBook should not copy. made_by is 'unclear': personal account, family-style content.
